title: Vet Invoice Invoice Amount Leaderboard
dataSources: Trupanion claims (`trupanion:claim`), vet invoices (`vet:invoice`), pet insurance premiums (`petinsurance:premium`), and vet visits (`vet:visit`).
app: Trupanion claim exports, veterinary invoice logs, pet insurance premium bills, and vet visit records streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vet:invoice invoice_usd=*
| stats sum(invoice_usd) as total_value, avg(invoice_usd) as avg_value by clinic_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks clinic values by total and average invoice amount across vet invoice events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `invoice_usd` values for each vet invoice event and review total and average invoice amount by clinic.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total invoice amount.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which clinic shows the biggest invoice amount numbers in your vet invoice data.
